text:
Noah: Heads-up  need a compact battlecard + 12 micro-scripts for SDRs for next week's launch. Target lanes: econ, uptime, and compliance. Keep scripts <=120 chars.
Aisha: Love the focus. Can we make each script pair with a one-line follow-up ask? Eg: 'Want a quick cost calc for your usage?'
Tom: For competitor angles: Cloud-managed = pricing opacity; LLM-API = model without serving; Infra-vendor = you still build orchestration. Two rebut bullets max.
Lina: Drafting quick pocket lines now. Drop raws, please edit for tone.
Noah: Also we need 3 short webinar hooks (<100 chars) for socials. Test variants: econ-first, reliability-first, technical-deep-dive.
Lina: Raw pocket lines (edit down):
```
Econ: "Same model, tuned batching & KV cache = 30-60% lower token spend in our 4k benchmark."
Uptime: "Cross-region fallback + model variants keeps apps serving during infra events."
Compliance: "Private control plane + KMS integrations for regulated data flows."
```
Aisha: Make econ number defensible: add slide footnote 'based on Redwood 4k-context benchmark with batching+cache enabled'.
Tom: Rebut bullets (short):
- Cloud-managed: "Simple API, hidden billing levers. No per-route batching knobs."
- LLM-API: "Models only  you still build routing, rollbacks, and caching."
- Infra-vendor: "Low-level libs; serving, rollouts, and fallbacks are still on you."
Noah: Good. For inbound routing map, keep it terse for CRM rules. Example: utm=cost -> SDR-econ, utm=security -> AE-enterprise, webinar=attended -> Demo-queue.
Aisha: I'll author 12 scripts: 4 econ, 4 uptime, 4 compliance. Each script + one follow-up ask + up to 2 rebut bullets. Will post by EOD.
Tom: I'll add an 'apples-to-apples' slide template listing model, context length, batching, quant profile, and KV-cache settings. Prevents nitpicks.
Lina: Webinar hooks:
1) "Live benchmark: same model, lower token spend."
2) "See how we keep p95 latency steady at scale."
3) "Deep dive: what we tuned to make it repeatable."
Noah: Nice. FieldBot: create doc stub /playbooks/micro-battlecard-v1.md and set reminder for review in 45m.
FieldBot: @channel doc stub created: /playbooks/micro-battlecard-v1.md. Reminder set. :bell:
Aisha: One more: add one-slide checklist for the field listing the key numbers to cite and the quick footnote language. Keeps legal happy.
Tom: I'll draft the CRM mapping snippet and a tiny automation playbook for demo queue routing.
Lina: After I trim the scripts, I'll ping #field-armory. Prefer conversational tone, not antagonistic.
Noah: Thanks team. Meeting in 45 to finalize copy.
